note: Synthetic contrasting wording: a fixed room cap with no proportionate deduction, a 10% co-pay, and a sub-limit on knee replacement.

rules.clause_text: Room rent is payable up to Rs. 4,000 per day. Charges above this are borne by the insured; other charges are not reduced.
Total knee replacement is payable up to Rs. 1,75,000 per knee, including implants.
The insured bears 10% of every admissible claim.
Consumables such as gloves and admission kits are not payable.
